description: Header file defining transfer-related data structures, constants, and function prototypes for managing file transfers, firmware upgrades, and time windows in a network device management context.

methods.name: transfers_transfer_add_info
methods.description: Adds transfer information to an object.

methods.name: transfers_transfer_del_info
methods.description: Removes transfer information from an object.

methods.name: transfers_handle_transfer
methods.description: Handles transfer process for an object.

methods.name: transfers_start_transfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer for an object.

methods.name: transfers_get_status
methods.description: Retrieves the current transfer status of an object.

methods.name: transfers_set_status
methods.description: Sets the transfer status of an object.

methods.name: transfers_firmwareupgrade_done
methods.description: Marks firmware upgrade as completed with result.

methods.name: transfers_timewindow_add_info
methods.description: Adds time window info to an object.

methods.name: transfers_timewindow_del_info
methods.description: Removes time window info from an object.

methods.name: transfers_timewindow_get_status
methods.description: Gets current status of a time window.

methods.name: transfers_timewindow_get_mode
methods.description: Gets mode of a time window.

methods.name: transfers_timewindow_get_maxretries
methods.description: Gets maximum retries for time window.

methods.name: transfers_timewindow_set_maxretries
methods.description: Sets maximum retries for time window.
